purpose: Continuously audit the Phi repository estate, repair safe defects, verify runtime behavior, and leave evidence-backed morning status.

actions: enumerate accessible Phi repositories
classify active, archive, experiment, library, service, site
locate deployment/runtime and owning requirements
do not modify repositories during classification
extract unresolved acceptance criteria
map each criterion to canonical repo/runtime
create scoped jobs rather than repo-wide rewrites
capture before evidence appropriate to job
skip irrelevant sensors
record broken behavior before repair
make smallest scoped repair
preserve working behavior
avoid unrelated style or architecture churn
create child job for separate defects
verifier must differ from writer
test exact acceptance criteria on deployed/runtime target when applicable
run regression checks on shared dependencies
return needs_work when evidence is insufficient
record repository, requirement, commit SHA, deployment/runtime, tests, timestamp, result and remaining defects
only verified jobs may become complete
summarize repositories scanned, jobs repaired, jobs verified, regressions found, blocked decisions and remaining unresolved work

unattended_allowed: classify and create scoped repair jobs
repair broken internal code, layouts, searches, media handling, schedules and integrations when no consequential external action is required
deploy repairs through an already-authorized existing deployment path when the change is reversible and within the repository's established purpose
record evidence and update implementation status after independent verification
requires_user_authorization: publish a new product or marketplace listing for sale
spend money or purchase paid services
transfer wallet assets or settle a real-value transaction
send messages to third parties as the user
expose, export or broaden access to customer shipping or other private information
delete repositories, durable customer/order data, or financial ledger history
change ownership, account recovery, authentication policy, secrets or payment credentials

regression_groups.rule: a channel repair must not regress working sibling playback or schedules
wallet repair must not create divergent balances or duplicate credits
commerce UI repair must preserve cart, reward, order and privacy boundaries
media repair must preserve playable known-good sources and phone-first layout
